comparison.objective: Seat a platform on three kinematic datums; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-contact alignment and seating on cup/groove/flat-style datums versus hex-bit insertion, screw torque, rotary adjustment, and dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: All three contacts pass 0.20 mm clearance tests, platform holds for one second, and robot releases versus two safe impact cycles within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Both require precision alignment, but datum seating tests constrained multi-point placement, not adjustment-and-lock commissioning.
